title: Sortable table: rows travel to their new places
blurb: A table with drawable on every row. A sort moves the rows in the DOM at once and the canvas draws each one flying from its old place to its new one, with its inputs live on the way.
question: Can each row of a real table be drawn on its own, so that a sort is shown as rows travelling while the table, its inputs and its sort buttons stay ordinary HTML?
result: Yes. A <tr drawable> keeps its table layout, can be drawn in the same task as the DOM move, and takes input at the drawn position.
